insight.headline: App Events: Send events from Admin UI extensions and embedded apps
insight.what_changed: Admin UI extensions and embedded apps can now send app events to Shopify with shopify.appEvents.emit(). At Editions, we launched app events for Checkout and Customer Account UI extensions. This release adds the Shopify admin, so you can now track app usage across all three surfaces. This is a new, optional API, so no action is required. What changed shopify.appEvents.emit() is now available on two…
